// diagnostic

E1263

No secret named `{name}`.

What

No secret named `{name}`.

Why

`jetpack secrets get {name}` decrypted the store (`.jet/secrets.age`) fine, but it has no entry called `{name}` (D-JPK-SECRETCRYPTO1).

Fix

Set it first with `jetpack secrets set {name} <value>`, or check the spelling.
